retentionPolicy: Keep full original JSON receipts, every verified image hash, and the five materially affected Organization/position-header PNGs. The other seven Configuration and 95 People PNGs are intentionally absent from this repository bundle.

pathSemantics.originalCapturePath: Logical path in the full local capture bundle; not a repository file link.
pathSemantics.retainedFile: Existing file relative to this manifest when retained=true; null for intentionally omitted PNGs.
pathSemantics.receiptPointer: JSON Pointer to the original record whose imageBytes and imageSHA256 bind this image.
